page.overview:
What is Dewford Town?

Dewford Town is a location introduced in Generation III.

Dewford Town is so far from the mainland, citizens are always eager to hear the latest news from newcomers. A man outside of the Dewford Hall will tell the player about the current trendy phrase. If the player says that the current phrase is not the hip and trendy thing, he or she can change it. The trendy phrase also affects where Feebas can appear.

Dewford Town is the second town in the Hoenn region to have its own Gymnasium. The Gym Leader is Brawly, who specializes in -type Pokémon, and he is fought in Dewford Town Gym. Brawly gives the Knuckle Badge to whoever defeats him.

If the player returns after obtaining the Balance Badge, the player can obtain TM36 from a Collector who appears near the entrance.
